uniteMoveEffects.name: Fairy Frolic
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Jump into the air and become briefly invincible. The moment Sylveon lands, deal damage to enemies in the area of effect and restore Sylveon's HP. For 10s afterward, 50% of damage dealt by Sylveon is converted into HP (basic attacks are excluded). Jump into the air, removing most statuses and becoming invincible. The moment Sylveon lands, lose invincibility and immediately gain Fairy Frolic buff, while dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and healing for 60% of the damage dealt. Fairy Frolic buff: for 10s, 50% of the damage dealt by Sylveon is converted into HP. No HP is recovered if the damage is dealt to shields. Against Wild Pokémon: Damage is capped at 2000. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
